description: Flow-cytometry gating from a FlowJo workspace (workspace) or Gating-ML 2.0 file (gatingml): the event count, percentage and medians of every population of the FCS file. Without workspace or gatingml, file is the gating file and the answer describes its samples and gate tree.

file.description: Path to the file or data-set directory.

medians.description: Parameters whose median over each population's events is reported under populations[].medians (`$PnN` or `$PnS`; `Comp-NAME` for compensated values), or `["all"]`: every parameter a gate uses, compensated as the gate reads it.

populations.description: Report only these populations (paths or unique names) and their descendants.

sample.description: Workspace sample name or id (default: matched by file name, then $FIL, then the only one).

strict.description: Refuse values the file's assurance does not validate (exit_code 6). Default: the server's.

workspace.description: FlowJo workspace (.wsp); `file` is then the FCS file to count events in.

name: openreadout_gate

fluorochromes.description: Rows: fluorochromes, or the detectors that receive the unmixed values.

name.description: Matrix name or id; `$SPILLOVER`/`$SPILL`/`SPILL` for the FCS file's own.

spectral.description: More detectors than rows: unmixed by ordinary least squares.

used.description: Whether a gate (or the table) used it.

PopulationNode.description: A node of the population tree.

count.description: Events (absent without an FCS file, and for quadrant-gate grouping nodes).

gate_type.description: Gate type, or `quadrant-gate` for the node grouping a quadrant gate's quadrants.

complement.description: Events outside the gate form the population (FlowJo `eventsInside="0"`).

coordinates.description: Coordinates are stored before the transform (`untransformed`, FlowJo) or after it.

count.description: Events in the population (absent when no FCS file was given).

gate.description:
Gate geometry as stored: `vertices`, `mean`/`covariance`/`distance_square`, `foci`/`edge`,
or `op`/`operands` (paths, with `complement`).

medians.description:
Median fluorescence (or scatter) of the population's events for each parameter asked for
(`analyze gate --median`), keyed by the name as asked: scale values (after `$PnE`/`$PnG`),
compensated when the name carries the workspace's `Comp-` prefix. Absent for an empty
population.

parent.description: Parent path; absent for populations of all events.

percent_of_parent.description: Percent of the parent population's events.

stored_count.description: The count the gating software stored (FlowJo `count`), for comparison.

compensation.description: Name of the sample's compensation matrix.

keywords.description: Keywords FlowJo stored with the sample (FCS TEXT plus its own).

population_count.description: Populations in the sample's gate tree.

uri.description: Where FlowJo found the FCS file.

TransformSummary.description: A parameter transform defined in the gating file.

id.description: Id (FlowJo: the parameter it applies to).

kind.description:
`linear`, `log`, `arcsinh`, `logicle`, `hyperlog`, `ratio`, `flowjo-log`, `flowjo-biex`,
`arcsinh-cofactor`, or the element name of an unsupported FlowJo transform.

supported.description: False for transforms this reader does not evaluate.

groups.description: Groups and their member sample names.

compensation.description: Compensation matrices the gating file defines (and whether any gate used them).

gating_file.description: The gating file (FlowJo workspace or Gating-ML document).

notes.description: Caveats: skipped populations, disagreements with counts stored in the workspace, scaling.

path.description: The FCS file gated; absent when only the gating file was described.

populations.description: One row per population, parents before children.

sample.description: The workspace sample whose gates were used (FlowJo only).

transforms.description: Transforms by id (FlowJo: by parameter name).

tree.description: The same populations as a tree (quadrant gates appear as grouping nodes without a count).
